info.name: Delivery App Backend APIs
info.description: Complete API collection with Admin and Customer folders, organized by functionality

item.name: Admin
item.description: Admin endpoints for managing the platform

item.name: Register Admin
item.description: Register a new admin (requires secret key)

item.name: Admin Login
item.description: Admin login with email and password

item.name: Get Revenue Report
item.description: Retrieves revenue metrics, trends, and breakdown

item.name: Get Product Performance
item.description: Retrieves product performance metrics including top performers and slow movers

item.name: Get Demographic Report
item.description: Retrieves customer demographics including gender, age, and location distribution

item.name: Get Funnel Report
item.description: Retrieves sales funnel metrics showing visitor to delivery conversion

item.name: Get Order Status Report
item.description: Retrieves order status distribution and trends over time

item.name: Get Payment & Refund Report
item.description: Retrieves payment methods, refund analytics, and transaction status.

query.description: Number of days to fetch data for (default: 30)

response.name: Payment & Refund Report Response

item.name: Get Inventory Report
item.description: Retrieves stock levels, inventory movement, and reorder information.

query.description: Number of days to fetch data for (default: 30)

response.name: Inventory Report Response

item.description: Update order status (PROCESSING, PACKED, ON_THE_WAY, DELIVERED, CANCELLED)
